links.outcome: AI accuracy detecting caries, fillings, missing teeth in pediatric panoramic radiographs versus adults/general population
links.effect: High specificity and accuracy (all above 85%) for caries, fillings and missing teeth, but low precision. Overall accuracy is lower for pediatric patients than for adults or the entire population.
links.quote: In conclusion, the overall accuracy of AI algorithms for evaluating permanent dentition in dental panoramic radiographs is lower for pediatric patients than adults or the entire population.

unlisted_practices: Adding primary-tooth identification to dental AI software so primary teeth are ignored when assessing mixed dentition

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic performance of an existing commercial/developed AI algorithm on a clinical sample of pediatric dental panoramic radiographs compared to expert ground truth.
